incidents_uptime_publication_state_check.name: incidents_uptime_publication_state_check
incidents_uptime_publication_state_check.value: ("incidents"."source_type" = 'uptime_monitor' AND "incidents"."uptime_publication_state" IN ('detected', 'published', 'ignored')) OR ("incidents"."source_type" = 'observability_alert' AND ("incidents"."uptime_publication_state" IS NULL OR "incidents"."uptime_publication_state" IN ('detected', 'published', 'ignored'))) OR ("incidents"."source_type" NOT IN ('uptime_monitor', 'observability_alert') AND "incidents"."uptime_publication_state" IS NULL)

incidents_public_title_check.name: incidents_public_title_check
incidents_public_title_check.value: "incidents"."public_title" IS NULL OR length(trim("incidents"."public_title")) BETWEEN 1 AND 160

secret_share_links_password_pair_check.name: secret_share_links_password_pair_check
secret_share_links_password_pair_check.value: ("secret_share_links"."password_salt" IS NULL AND "secret_share_links"."password_verifier" IS NULL) OR ("secret_share_links"."password_salt" IS NOT NULL AND "secret_share_links"."password_verifier" IS NOT NULL)
